scope: Offline Pythonic local motion clauses and finite supplied progress; no trajectories or controller acceptance
source: MOVE comma followed by 1..32 local WHEN/DO or UNTIL/optional THEN clauses, ending in ENDMOVE; Pythonic Boolean expression and captured routine/USING values
scanning: Global scans first, independent one-shot clauses in source order at entry and supplied progress checkpoints; local event/error/edge cursors are isolated and purged
until: Cancel the current group before THEN actions; continue after ENDMOVE unless task control or failure terminates/suspends execution
progress: Optional response delay_ms in 0..86400000, bounded 10 ms cooperative steps; progress excludes callback/hold time, no native timing inference
controls: Unqualified local controls target the active group; holds suspend local scans/progress while global polling continues; task abort/pause requests must be honored before completion
ownership: Retain root and opaque grant identity across linked calls; changed ownership/work labels fail without overwriting foreign/stopped state
lifetime: Pause retains local scope and remaining progress; stop/abort cancel, runtime/budget failures fail; finally purge consumers and remove transient work state
persistence: Active saves and pending-history reload are rejected; completed data validates bounded progress, clauses, trigger indexes and outcomes; old zero-duration payloads remain unchanged
remaining: NOWAIT with local clauses or delayed completion
Native scan timing and multi-group synchronization
